"""Temporal, safety-first candidate controller for target-directed motion."""

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
MOTION_ACTIONS = ("FORWARD", "VEER_LEFT", "VEER_RIGHT")


def safety_contract(observation, memory):
    """Stop whenever confidence is low or collision risk is high."""
    if (
        float(observation["safety_confidence"]) < 0.60
        or float(observation["closing_risk"]) >= 0.75
    ):
        memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
        memory["last_action"] = "STOP"
        return "STOP", 0.99
    return None


def tracking_contract(observation, memory):
    """Verify target identity and scan or pause without advancing when unreliable."""
    visible = bool(observation["target_visible"])
    reliable = (
        visible
        and float(observation["target_confidence"]) >= 0.55
        and float(observation["target_identity_confidence"]) >= 0.60
    )
    if reliable:
        if int(observation["track_age"]) < 2:
            memory["state"] = "VERIFY"
            memory["last_action"] = "SLOW_DOWN"
            return "SLOW_DOWN", 0.80
        return None

    lost_steps = max(0, int(observation["lost_steps"]))
    if memory.get("state") in {"LOCKED", "APPROACH", "REACQUIRE"} and lost_steps <= 1:
        memory["state"] = "REACQUIRE"
        memory["last_action"] = "STOP"
        return "STOP", 0.92

    direction = "SCAN_LEFT" if lost_steps % 2 == 0 else "SCAN_RIGHT"
    memory["state"] = "SEARCH"
    memory["last_action"] = direction
    return direction, 0.75


def propose_moves(observation, memory):
    """Rank corridor-safe moves by bearing alignment, then by forward efficiency."""
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    candidates = []

    if bearing < -10.0 and observation["corridor_left"]:
        candidates.append("VEER_LEFT")
    elif bearing > 10.0 and observation["corridor_right"]:
        candidates.append("VEER_RIGHT")

    if abs(bearing) <= 10.0 and observation["corridor_center"]:
        candidates.append("FORWARD")

    if observation["corridor_center"]:
        candidates.append("FORWARD")
    if bearing < 0.0 and observation["corridor_left"]:
        candidates.append("VEER_LEFT")
    if bearing > 0.0 and observation["corridor_right"]:
        candidates.append("VEER_RIGHT")
    if observation["corridor_left"]:
        candidates.append("VEER_LEFT")
    if observation["corridor_right"]:
        candidates.append("VEER_RIGHT")

    return list(dict.fromkeys(candidates))


def progress_contract(observation, memory, candidates):
    """Use short temporal hysteresis to preserve a useful steering direction."""
    if not candidates:
        return None

    previous = memory.get("last_action")
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])

    if previous in candidates:
        if (
            (previous == "VEER_LEFT" and bearing < -4.0)
            or (previous == "VEER_RIGHT" and bearing > 4.0)
            or (previous == "FORWARD" and abs(bearing) <= 14.0)
        ):
            return previous

    return candidates[0]


def termination_contract(observation, memory):
    """Return a conservative stop when no safe progress proposal exists."""
    memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
    memory["last_action"] = "STOP"
    return "STOP", 0.98


def decide(observation, memory):
    """Compose safety, tracking, arrival, progress, and termination contracts."""
    memory = dict(memory or {})

    safety = safety_contract(observation, memory)
    if safety is not None:
        return safety[0], safety[1], memory

    tracking = tracking_contract(observation, memory)
    if tracking is not None:
        return tracking[0], tracking[1], memory

    memory["state"] = "LOCKED"
    near = observation["target_distance_class"] == "near"
    identity_confidence = float(observation["target_identity_confidence"])
    heading_error = abs(float(observation["heading_error"]))

    if near and heading_error <= 15.0 and identity_confidence >= 0.80:
        memory["state"] = "ARRIVED"
        memory["last_action"] = "ARRIVED"
        return "ARRIVED", 0.96, memory

    if near:
        bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
        preferred = "VEER_LEFT" if bearing < 0.0 else "VEER_RIGHT"
        candidates = [preferred] if preferred in MOTION_ACTIONS else []
        if not candidates:
            candidates = propose_moves(observation, memory)
    else:
        candidates = propose_moves(observation, memory)

    action = progress_contract(observation, memory, candidates)
    if action is None:
        fallback = termination_contract(observation, memory)
        return fallback[0], fallback[1], memory

    memory["state"] = "APPROACH"
    memory["last_action"] = action
    return action, 0.90, memory


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
